author_method: Independent source-only review; no author builds/tests. Parent owns standalone published-crate probes.
agreed: Not a full replacement for the installed file navigation and agent-output stack.
Can replace the editable file-content view; its public Code token-range API could replace the syntax backend after a separate migration.
Filesystem navigation, bounded file I/O, host save policy, chat Markdown/streaming and reported-patch parsing remain separate.
Code accepts an explicit language and generic style mapping through highlight_interval. Hex construction and extension mapping are convenience APIs, not fundamental Code limitations.
There are 16 unconditional grammar crates and 17 parser identifiers including markdown-inline. Custom queries do not add new parsers.
The probe automatically resolved tree-sitter-language 0.1.7 for Rust 1.89; 0.1.8 requires1.90. Keep a compatible lockfile.
Current recommendation: no replacement now; evaluate as a future explicit file editor with original-versus-unsaved-buffer comparison.
integration_gaps: Light-theme base styles and selection styling
Input event/shortcut routing and missing navigation keys
Bounded work/cache and broader syntax coverage if replacing the chat backend
File load/save conflict, permission and concurrency contract
unverified: Reviewer hypothesis about Markdown injection matching
